nodes.label: Etsy agentic shop-management space: the shop-level orchestrator
nodes.description: One orchestrated system connecting market research -> AutoDesign -> listing automation -> POD fulfillment, with all state durable in the knowledge graph. Sits ABOVE Poster Studio and the autodesign-etsy branch; does not reinvent design or listing.

nodes.label: agents/etsy_researcher.py - shop intelligence & market research
nodes.description: Periodically samples target niches (maps, posters, gold-foil, personalized gifts) via the Apify Etsy MCP Scraper / Jentic listings endpoints; logs features (colours, layout, messaging, price bands, bestseller patterns) into the graph; emits design briefs + keyword packs.

nodes.label: pipelines/poster_creative.yml - creative pipeline orchestration
nodes.description: Feeds research-derived design briefs into AutoDesign (autodesign-etsy branch) -> Poster Studio SVG template engine -> framed-mockup + listing-image pipeline. Optional promo-video hook.

nodes.label: agents/etsy_lister.py - listing & pricing automation
nodes.description: Takes generated assets + keyword packs; calls Etsy v3 (via Jentic or the MCP server) to create/update listings, sections, inventory, personalization, pricing rules. Scheduled SEO-refresh: rotate weak tags, seasonal keywords, title/description A/B tests.

nodes.label: agents/pod_router.py - fulfillment & POD routing
nodes.description: Listens for new Etsy receipts; picks a POD provider (Prodigi / Printify / Merchize) by size, destination, all-in cost; pushes the order via that provider's API. Writes a unified cost/margin ledger.

nodes.label: agents/shop_health_monitor.py - shop ops & customer comms
nodes.description: Tracks shop state (open orders, message queue, review score, listing performance); drafts replies / review follow-ups / resolutions from templates via the Shop Management API.

nodes.label: tools/jentic_client.py - secure Etsy v3 execution layer
nodes.description: Wraps Jentic One: agents call Jentic, Jentic calls Etsy Open API v3 with the app credentials. Agents never see secrets; full request logging.

nodes.label: tools/etsy_mcp_client.py - MCP tool-call surface
nodes.description: Wraps the Etsy MCP server (and the Apify Etsy MCP Scraper for research) so agents issue structured tool calls: create listing, update tags, get active listings, list receipts, search listings.

nodes.label: Poster Studio (/home/dev/poster-studio) - SVG template engine + Etsy draft factory
nodes.description: Existing project: browser poster designer, 300 DPI export, competitor->listing factory pipeline, Etsy draft creation. This branch consumes it; does not duplicate it.

nodes.label: autodesign-etsy branch - competitor extraction + novel design generation
nodes.description: Existing Agentic Universe branch: CLIP-based design-element extraction, style clustering, Stable-Diffusion template generation, PosterBench scoring (AutoDesign, arXiv 2608.13560).

nodes.label: Build an internal orchestrator, not another SaaS competitor
nodes.description: InsightAgent / Merch Titans / eRank etc. prove demand but are vendor-locked silos. The edge here is gluing research + design + listing + fulfillment for our own shops with graph-durable state - not selling a tool.

nodes.label: API/MCP first; headless browser only for true API gaps
nodes.description: Primary path: Jentic One (secure execution, agents never see secrets) wrapped by the Etsy MCP server. Research path: Apify Etsy MCP Scraper. Playwright/Browser-Use from WSL2 is a secondary path for off-API flows only, given low TOS risk tolerance.

nodes.label: Every listing experiment is a scored forecast, not a vibe
nodes.description: Adopt the epistemic-market discipline (epistemic_constitution.py, main graph runs 293/296): an A/B test predicts a conversion/revenue lift, is scored on resolution, and calibration is kept per niche. A listing A/B test is a paired live trial - treat it like one.

nodes.label: Dedicated branch off main with agents/pipelines/schemas/tools layout
nodes.description: Physically separate from proposals/ and autodesign-etsy; shares .git history. Skeleton: agents/*.py, pipelines/*.yml, schemas/*.yaml, tools/*_client.py, this note + this graph.

nodes.label: Stop-at-draft gate: no auto-publish to a live listing
nodes.description: Inherited from poster-studio. Every listing write stops at DRAFT; publishing to a live listing needs explicit owner approval.

nodes.label: Agents never see Etsy / POD credentials
nodes.description: Credentials live only in the Jentic execution layer and the POD-provider adapters. This is why Jentic is the primary path.

nodes.label: Etsy payments received through the Estonian company
nodes.description: POD research done: Prodigi / Printify / Merchize cheapest; gold-foil printing for US-heavy demand. The cost/margin ledger must reflect this.

nodes.label: Stay within Etsy TOS - no ad-hoc scraping of authenticated flows
nodes.description: Research scraping is limited to the Apify Etsy MCP Scraper's public search surface; authenticated actions go through the official API via Jentic.

nodes.label: The single highest-value next move
nodes.description: Stand up tools/jentic_client.py + tools/etsy_mcp_client.py against the sandbox and get one read-only round trip (get active listings) working end to end. Everything else depends on the integration layer.

nodes.label: What are the research playbooks (niches, crawl frequency, features)?
nodes.description: Define the sampling strategy: which niches, top-N by niche, crawl cadence, which features to extract into the graph.

nodes.label: Fill schemas/pod_cost_model.yaml with real Prodigi/Printify/Merchize numbers
nodes.description: Per-provider: size -> base cost, shipping by destination, turnaround, quality notes. The router's decision logic is only as good as this table.

nodes.label: Design schemas/experiment_listing_ab_test.yaml
nodes.description: A listing experiment record: hypothesis, predicted lift + confidence, variant definitions, start/stop, resolution metric, Brier on resolve. Mirrors the forecast ledger.

nodes.label: How exactly does a design brief hand off to AutoDesign + Poster Studio?
nodes.description: The brief -> SVG -> mockup -> listing-asset contract between this branch, autodesign-etsy, and poster-studio is undefined. Needs a schema. RESOLVED (contract drafted): contracts/poster_studio_interface.md + poster_creative.yml now define the four calls. The poster-studio side (wrap as a module vs shell out to run_stage.py) is ps__q_relation_to_etsy_branches in the poster-studio audit graph.

nodes.label: contracts/poster_studio_interface.md - the callable seam to poster-studio
nodes.description: render_design / make_mockups / finalize_images / create_draft, derived from the agentic-universe first-pass poster-studio audit (run 318). Stop-at-draft, artifact-on-disk, one-ref-one-prompt, no-customer-data, templates-read-only invariants. poster_creative.yml now calls these instead of naming stages abstractly.
